FIELDS.NAME: Crystal Clean Dry Cleaners
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Crystal Clean Dry Cleaners, we specialize in providing high-quality dry cleaning and laundry services for a wide range of fabrics, ensuring exceptional care and satisfaction for our customers. Our operations include the cleaning, pressing, and finishing of garments, as well as offering minor alterations and repairs. We prioritize the use of environmentally friendly cleaning agents while adhering strictly to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding chemical use and disposal. Our state-of-the-art equipment is serviced annually by certified technicians, ensuring both operational efficiency and safety standards are consistently met. We maintain meticulous records of all maintenance activities to verify compliance and operational integrity. With our customer-centric approach, we also offer a convenient pick-up and delivery service within the local community, enhancing accessibility to our services while ensuring garments receive the highest standard of care throughout the cleaning process. Our commitment to quality and regulatory compliance helps us provide a reliable resource for our valued customers, ensuring their garments are treated with the utmost professionalism and respect.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Clothing alteration and repair services operated under the same management, ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2023, Cause: Equipment malfunction during routine cleaning operation leading to a minor fire incident, Amount: $1,200.00, Status: Closed
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security personnel on-site to safeguard equipment and facility.
